decisions.Kwic: 諸仁者！到恁麼地，正好高高峰頂立，深深海底行，

Decision.AttributionNote: 法璽印禪師語錄, celebratory hall address. Faxi Yin is the exact speaker: he says that upon recognizing the present occasion one may stand on the highest peak and walk in the deepest ocean, before calling this still a course of establishment and transformation.
